title: Chapter 419 Burning Flames
content:
Chapter 419 Burning Flames

As soon as the sun god fire appeared, the tree demon's heart trembled spontaneously, and the incomparable sense of fear was hard to contain, and the whole demon felt bad.

The Sun God Fire turned out to be the legendary Sun God Fire.

How could this be possible, the man in the imperial robe on the opposite side was only at the sixth rank in terms of aura. Although it was a bit stronger than the tree demon itself, it was far from the seventh rank.

But why can a mere sixth-level strength be able to do things that even eighth-level strength may not be able to do.

That's the sun fire.

According to the rumors, the sun is extremely fierce and difficult to get close to, and has a haughty personality, so it is basically impossible to be tamed.

Since ancient times, this entire world has produced countless talented and gorgeous generations, and all of these geniuses have strong cultivation bases and suppressed a generation.

But whenever the geniuses tried to subdue the sun god fire, they all failed. Some people even didn't believe in this evil and wanted to use force, but ended up being burnt to ashes by the sun's real fire instead.

At this point, those strong geniuses realized that the Sun True Fire Art is not something they can easily control.

Time has passed, and hundreds of thousands of years have passed since the birth of the world. Except in the ancient times, there was a rumor that there was an emperor of the monster race, and the three-legged Golden Crow once controlled the real fire of the sun. Heaven has conquered, and no one else.

But, whether it is the three-legged Golden Crow or the Great Emperor Haotian. These existences are rumored to have surpassed the eighth-level immortal gods and reached the power of the ninth-level golden immortal.

Now the Zhong Yu in front of him is only at the peak of the sixth order, so how can he be able to master the real fire of the sun.

"No, no, I must have read it wrong. This divine fire is just a bit similar to the real fire of the sun. How can a mere celestial master have such luck and strength? The delusional sun fire." The tree demon kept comforting himself in his heart, finding another excuse for what he saw in front of him to soothe the fear that couldn't rise.

In fact, it wasn't just the tree demon, Yan Chixia who was next to her also felt a burst of horror when she saw the appearance of the real fire of the sun, she couldn't believe it.

The real fire of the sun, as a legendary life, cannot be controlled unless it is powerful enough to overwhelm ancient and modern people. What does it mean when it appears now?

Yan Chixia, who is well versed in both Buddhism and Taoism, did not question his identity as the real fire of the sun for the divine fire that appeared in front of him.

After all, the masculine, majestic, domineering aura emanating from it cannot be concealed, and the pure golden color is consistent with the real fire of the sun mentioned in ancient books.

In fact, what Yan Chixia and the tree demon don't know is that Zhong Yu's skills are born with the artistic conception of dominating everything, coupled with the personality he cultivated, and the aura that can imitate the Dao of Heaven, summon a Compared with the difficulties of others, the real fire of the sun is not too simple, it is nothing at all.

In some respects, this can be regarded as a kind of compensation for the limitation of his life span.

After the real fire of the sun appeared, the tree demon had just tried his best, and the idea of trying to save his life was in vain.

As an extremely sinister monster, it was only possible to cultivate to its present level with the help of external forces. The tree demon's grandma's magic power was so mixed that the whole monster was stuck in a bottleneck, no matter how difficult it was to improve her cultivation level.

Although the overall strength is considered strong in the sixth level, it is nothing at all against the evil spirit nemesis like Shangyang Zhenhuo.

"Fall!" Zhong Yu said.

Then, the incomparably hot sun's real fire fell from the sky, splashed onto the tree demon's body with a whirring sound, and sparked bursts of sparks.

These sparks fell on the tree demon's leaves, and they burst into flames with a plop. The evil aura that the tree demon couldn't hide was like the best fuel, bringing greater life force to these sparks. It burned more and more vigorously, and gradually became a raging fire.

In a short while, the whole body of the tree demon was on fire. The golden flame looked like a big torch from a distance. The light was shining under the real fire of the sun, which was comparable to the scorching sun in the sky, and the two competed for brilliance.

ah……

The miserable wailing of the tree demon sounded again, it was cold and cold, making people feel chills all over. The accompanying demon vines were also burned by the flames and spread all over the body. Countless branches and vines waved in the air, like tentacle monsters, looking extremely scary.

The trees and vines waved their vines and wanted to use the wind to extinguish the divine fire, but it was a pity that the real fire of the sun was one of the top ten real fires, and it ranked among the top three among these real fires, so it was not for nothing.

The wind brought by the mere waving of the body can't extinguish this kind of divine fire, but the wind helps the fire, making the sun's divine fire burn more vigorously, and the whole body of the tree demon and tree vines is filled with divine fire, and they can no longer escape .

After a while, under the burning of the divine fire, the tree demon and tree vines were completely reduced to a mass of ashes and fell to the ground, forming a black dirt bag more than three meters high, which was extremely ugly with pits and holes.

The dryad was wiped out, and finally his divine sense swept across a radius of tens of miles. He searched over and over again within the original range of the dryad forest, carefully looking for what he believed to be the scheme of the old Black Mountain demon.

Sure enough, under the ground of Lanruo Temple, an open fault with a depth of 100 meters appeared. The fault was filled with altars one after another. The altars were carved with mysterious spells, forming a small magic circle together.

Zhong Yu studied it carefully and found that this small method is an important channel to communicate Yin and Yang, and connect the two worlds, which is commonly known as the portal.

Through this portal, the Black Mountain old demon can directly and quickly transfer the monster soldiers from the underworld to the Yang world, so as to achieve its purpose of quickly mobilizing troops.

It is estimated that the tree demon grandma is the guard arranged by the old black mountain demon in front of the portal to maintain the stability of the portal at all times and prevent others from investigating.

Now that the conspiracy of the Black Mountain old demon has been discovered, and the purpose of this trip has been achieved, Zhong Yu naturally will not be troublesome, and wants to go to the underworld through the portal.

With a sweep of Zhong Yu's divine sense, more than ten altars in the fault immediately turned into powder. Under a bright light, the large array formed by the altars turned into an extremely turbulent and majestic energy, which shot in all directions and completely disappeared. .

In the next few days, the army continued to be stationed on the charred woods and did not evacuate the small county.

Zhong Yu planned to wait here for a few days to see if the Black Mountain old demon would take any other actions after the teleportation formation was destroyed, such as forcibly opening the barrier between Yin and Yang, and going to Lanruo Temple for revenge.

After all, with the ability of the Montenegro old demon, it is not difficult to do this. The portal just makes the Montenegro old demon save a little effort.
